title: Hermeus product stage
description: A light grey band: the index label, a short paragraph with a crop-mark button at the right, then a stage where a huge two-line name in pale grey sits behind a wide cut-out render, with small amber + hotspots pinned on it, each sending out a pulsing amber ring. Hovering a hotspot shows its label; on phones the hotspots hide and thin chevrons at the sides step through them.
notes: the render slot is 2.58:1 across the column; hotspot x/y are percentages of that box
needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible) for the phone arrows; the desktop hotspots and their hover labels work without it
the backdrop name uses the secondary colour on the muted band
name: hermeus-product
